0022600153.text: The Thunder (4-1, first in the Northwest and fourth in the West) are on a one-game losing streak after a 1-1 road record, while the Rockets (5-0, first in the Southwest and the West) have won five straight. Oklahoma City is without Alex Caruso (ankle), Cason Wallace (shoulder), Jalen Williams (leg fracture), Nikola Topic (back), and Thomas Sorber (knee), and Chet Holmgren (knee) is day-to-day and a game-time decision. Houston is missing Reed Sheppard (back) and Steven Adams (calf strain). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, but the Thunder won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, although they lost the most recent meeting 112-106 in Oklahoma City on February 7, 2026.
